sources.title: Tesseract OCR — Free Open Source OCR Engine (Download)
sources.snippet: Tesseract is the free, open-source OCR engine for extracting text from images and scanned PDFs in 100+ languages, fully offline. Install guides, CLI, Python and an online demo.

sources.title: Tesseract OCR Documentation — Install, Configure & Integrate
sources.snippet: Tesseract OCR — Open Source Text Recognition Engine Tesseract OCR is a deep-learning engine designed to extract machine-readable text from images and PDFs. Use this documentation to master installation on Windows, Linux, and macOS, configure AI engine modes, and integrate OCR into your software pipelines.
